summary: The change adds a 'report:' prefix to the payments is_allowed() function, transparently mapping 'report:X' to the existing grant for 'X' without altering the GRANTS set, the PRIVILEGED set, or any route. All four product obligations whose scope includes rbac.py (ACC-1, ACC-2, SOD-1, MFA-1) remain satisfied because no new effective grants or privileged routes are introduced. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-5) are met: the ticket is approved and covers the right component, an independent change_approver and a security_reviewer both approved the sole commit, and CI passed on the final commit with all 172 tests green including every relevant control test. No protected paths, emergency conditions, or exceptions are involved, so CHG-6, CHG-7, EXC-1, and LAP-1 are not triggered.
